selected_evidence.requirement: Require at least 12 characters and three character classes
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent policy, PAM integration, rejection of an 11-character password, rejection of a two-class password, and acceptance of a compliant password before and after reboot.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID b68f3414-19d9-40e1-b341-c77af244584e, running system state, and recovered policy enforcement.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf '%s\n' '--- authselect ---'
authselect current 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- pam pwquality references ---'
grep -Hn 'pam_pwquality' /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- pwquality effective config sources ---'
grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*(minlen|minclass)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- package ---'
rpm -q libpwquality pam 2>&1
commands.stdout:

--- authselect ---

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d
tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/.99-password-policy.XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' '# Managed password complexity policy' 'minlen = 12' 'minclass = 3' > "$tmpfile"
chmod 0644 "$tmpfile"
chown root:root "$tmpfile"
mv -f "$tmpfile" /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
restorecon /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'installed:'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
commands.stdout:
installed:
-rw-r--r-- root:root /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
# Managed password complexity policy
minlen = 12
minclass = 3

commands.command:
set +e
run_case() {
  label=$1
  value=$2
  printf '%s: ' "$label"
  result=$(printf '%s\n' "$value" | pwscore 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  printf 'rc=%s output=%s\n' "$rc" "$result"
}
run_case '11_chars_4_classes' 'Ab1!defghij'
run_case '12_chars_2_classes' 'ABCDEFGHIJ12'
run_case '12_chars_3_classes' 'Z7vQ2mN8pL4x'
printf '%s\n' '--- active PAM hooks ---'
grep -Hn '^[[:space:]]*password[[:space:]].*pam_pwquality\.so' /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth
printf '%s\n' '--- configured policy ---'
grep -HnE '^[[:space:]]*(minlen|minclass)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
commands.stdout:
11_chars_4_classes: rc=1 output=Password quality check failed:
 The password is shorter than 12 characters
12_chars_2_classes: rc=1 output=Password quality check failed:
 The password contains less than 3 character classes
12_chars_3_classes: rc=0 output=31

[REDACTED]]]]    requisite     pam_pwquality.so try_first_pass local_users_only retry=3 authtok_type=
[REDACTED]]]] configured policy ---
/etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf:2:minlen = 12
/etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf:3:minclass = 3

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
printf 'policy_file='; stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(minlen|minclass)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
printf 'pam_hooks='; grep -l '^[[:space:]]*password[[:space:]].*pam_pwquality\.so' /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth | tr '\n' ' '; printf '\n'
printf 'functional_compliant='; printf '%s\n' 'Z7vQ2mN8pL4x' | pwscore
commands.stdout:
boot_id=fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6
system_state=running
policy_file=-rw-r--r-- root:root /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
minlen = 12
minclass = 3
pam_hooks=/etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth 
functional_compliant=31
